raw_segments.text: His gaze brooded on his broad-toed boots a buck's cast-off's nebinane ender.
He counted the creases of rucked leather wherein another's foot had nested warm.
The foot that beat the ground in tripeudium, foot I dislove.
But you were delighted when Esther Osvalt's shoe went on you, girl I knew in Paris, tines
